          JPanel quickLaunchBar
          The pinned quick-launch strip and the model behind it. The strip sits between the start button and the running-window buttons, mirroring the 3D taskbar's left-aligned shortcuts container; it is rebuilt whenever the model fires a change (a pin, un-pin or reorder) or the icon scale changes, and the current scale is kept so a rebuild draws the right size.
